GeoBigDataExecuteGeoSPARQL: Execute the caller-supplied GeoSPARQL query on a configured spatial RDF endpoint over original RDF geometries. Return actual SPARQL results; backend errors propagate, with no answer lookup.

JSON object with required executable SPARQL field "query". source_id and gold fields are forbidden. The operator configures GEOSPARQL_ENDPOINT with original YAGO2geo RDF loaded. Do not invent an endpoint or use a question as a parameter. Compile the natural-language request to YAGO2geo GeoSPARQL using: named entities yago:Name_With_Underscores; feature classes y2geoo:OSM_park/forest/lake/stream/beach/island/lagoon/nature_reserve/locality/village/canal, administrative classes y2geoo:OS_County/OS_District/OSI_County_Council/OSI_City_and_County_Council/OSI_Rural_Area/OSI_Townland/GAG_Municipality; geometry pattern ?feature geo:hasGeometry ?geometry . ?geometry geo:asWKT ?wkt; spatial functions geof:sfWithin/sfContains/sfIntersects/sfTouches/sfCrosses/distance and strdf:area/above/below/left. Use SELECT, aggregates, GROUP BY, ORDER BY and LIMIT as requested. The lightweight backend evaluates area in native coordinate squared units. Only geo:wktLiteral without an explicit CRS has the OGC default known CRS84 and square-degree area. Plain/xsd:string WKT and strdf:WKT without a CRS declaration have unknown CRS and unknown native squared units; do not label them square degrees or square metres. A supported explicit CRS declaration supplies known CRS and its native area units. Directions require strictly separated geometry extents. Two unknown CRS operands support only native-plane topology/directions without coordinate conversion or geographic unit claims. Mixed known/unknown CRS relations and any distance with an unknown CRS raise errors. Explicit strdf:WKT with north-first CRS axes is unsupported and raises an error; do not substitute the GeoSPARQL axis convention. Known-CRS linear distance is supported for projected geometries and geographic points; exact disjoint geographic polygon/line distance in metres is unsupported and raises an error. Invalid or non-2D geometries also raise errors. The default project-local store globally retains rdf:type, RDFS domain/range/subClassOf/subPropertyOf, owl:sameAs, original geometry and gazetteer fields, and YAGO isLocatedIn/partOf/hasArea/hasPreferredName/hasGloss/hasCapital/hasNeighbor/hasLength/hasHeight/hasPopulation/hasPopulationDensity. It does not retain complete rdfs:label or coordinate-property facts. Queries needing an excluded existing predicate, a variable predicate or an unsafe whole-graph zero-length path return a scope error, never a partial aggregate. Prefixes may be omitted. Optional dataset is provenance only.
